name: KINLINK Continuity & Comms
purpose: repair missed communication with normal human French emails, then resume KINLINK automatically with a fresh CONTINUER tranche and at least one bounded safe product/continuity action
invariants: Intermediate PDF/report/artifact mail is neither START nor END unless explicitly typed.
Never send duplicate END after provider ACK already exists.
Notify only after a real repair or unresolved fault requiring human action.
Recovered END emails use normal human French and explain completed work, current truth, remaining work and exact next action.
After repairing an interrupted tranche, auto-resume is user-authorized only when no human/security/platform gate exists.
A failover START is legal only if the same automation immediately performs at least one real bounded next action.
The automation must not leave an orphan START; before its run ends it checkpoints and closes unless a real foreground worker owns the tranche.
idempotency: Provider message_id/thread_id plus delivery_key are reconciliation keys.
limitation: Hourly watchdog cannot guarantee sub-hour repair; primary in-turn protocol remains the first line of defense.

stale_work_recovery.condition: START_ACKNOWLEDGED/WORKING with no END and START age >= 28 minutes unless durable state proves an intentional active extension
stale_work_recovery.action: persist interruption close intent from durable facts only, send/verify exactly one END, persist CLOSED

foreground_resume.rule: After a repaired close and absent true human/security gate, open a fresh tranche, send/ACK a normal START, execute at least one bounded safe NEXT_UNCOMMITTED_ACTION, then checkpoint and close before automation run end unless a real foreground worker owns the active tranche.

close_intent_priority.rule: CLOSE_INTENT_PERSISTED/END_SEND_PENDING/no_more_product_mutations/status=CLOSING with no durable END ACK is a P0 missed-END fault independent of age.
close_intent_priority.repair: verify START thread and existing END first; then persist ACK or send exactly one truthful END; provider readback; persist CLOSED

primary_protocol_deadline.note: Automation is hourly and cannot guarantee minute-25 delivery; the foreground protocol remains primary.

email_style.start_rule: Mot d’ordre : CONTINUER + durable next action + A+B+C/W-wave context
